ei.title: The Importance of Showing You Care
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: When it comes to helping out, you don't have to do much. All you have to do is come around and show that you care. If you notice someone who is lonely, you could go and sit with them. If you work with someone who eats lunch all by themselves, and you go and sit down with them, they will begin to be more social after a while, and they will owe it all to you. A person's happiness comes from attention. There are too many people out in the world who feel like everyone has forgotten them or ignored them. Even if you say hi to someone passing by, they will begin to feel better about themselves, like someone cares.

questions.passage: When it comes to helping out, you don't have to do much. All you have to ①<u>do is come</u> around and show that you care. If you notice someone ②<u>who are lonely</u>, you could go and sit with them. If you work with someone who ③<u>eats</u> lunch all by themselves, and you go and sit down with them, they will begin to be more social after a while, and they will owe it all to you. A person's happiness comes from attention. There are too many people out in the world who feel like everyone has forgotten them or ignored them. Even if you say hi to someone ④<u>passing</u> by, they will begin to feel better about themselves, like someone cares.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② who are lonely → who is lonely: 선행사 someone(단수)에 맞는 is
det.analysis:
✅ ① do is come: 'All you have to do is come around'에서 원형부정사 보어 — 적절

❌ ② who are lonely → who is lonely: 'someone who is lonely'에서 선행사 someone은 단수이므로 관계절 동사는 is가 적절. are는 수 일치 오류 ← 정답

✅ ③ eats: 'someone who eats lunch'에서 선행사 someone(단수)에 맞는 단수 동사 — 적절

✅ ④ passing: 'someone passing by'에서 someone을 수식하는 현재분사 — 적절
det.tip: someone who is lonely (선행사 someone=단수 → is)

det.analysis:

✅ ② sit down: 'go and sit down with them'에서 and로 연결된 동사원형 — 적절

❌ ③ is too many people → are too many people: 'There are too many people out in the world'에서 'There + be동사' 구문의 실제 주어는 people(복수)이므로 are가 적절. is는 수 일치 오류 ← 정답

det.tip: There are + 복수명사 (too many people → are)

❌ ① 결코 변하지 않음: 본문은 '더 사교적으로 변한다'고 함 — 불일치

✅ ② 함께 앉아 주면 더 사교적: 본문 'they will begin to be more social after a while'와 일치 ← 정답

지나가는 사람에게 인사하면 그들은 오히려 더 불안해한다.
세상에는 자신이 사랑받는다고 느끼는 사람이 너무 많다.

questions.passage: When it comes to helping out, you don't have to do much. All you have to do is come around and show that you care. If you notice someone who is lonely, you could go and sit with them. If you work with someone who eats lunch all by themselves, and you go and sit down with them, they will begin to be more social after a while, and they will owe it all to you. __________ comes from attention. There are too many people out in the world who feel like everyone has forgotten them or ignored them. Even if you say hi to someone passing by, they will begin to feel better about themselves, like someone cares.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: A person's happiness=한 사람의 행복
det.analysis:
✅ ① A person's happiness: '__________ comes from attention'에서 글 전체가 관심이 외로운 사람의 기분을 나아지게 함을 다루므로 관심에서 오는 것은 '한 사람의 행복(a person's happiness)'이 적절 ← 정답

❌ ② A nation's wealth(한 나라의 부): 관심에서 온다는 맥락과 무관

❌ ③ A child's growth(아이의 성장): 문맥과 무관

❌ ④ A team's victory(팀의 승리): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: A person's happiness comes from attention = 사람의 행복은 관심에서 온다

[조건] (1) comes, helping, it, out, to, when을 모두 사용할 것 (2) 정확히 6단어로 쓸 것 (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: When it comes to helping out = 돕는 것에 관해서라면
det.analysis: 본문 S1 'When it comes to helping out, you don't have to do much'에서 발췌. 'when it comes to + 동명사'는 '~에 관해서라면'이라는 관용 표현. 비인칭 주어 it + comes + to + 동명사(helping out). 6단어.
det.tip: when it comes to + V-ing = ~에 관해서라면
